svg.text: HF weights: names, three load channels, and the checks
example names; L = checkpoint layer, n_layer = num_hidden_layers from config.json
How does a checkpoint name find its parameter?
hf_to_model gives the parameter path. build_coverage puts the name into one of three channels.
What does each channel do with the bytes and the scales?
load_covered_params runs the three channels in this order. Each channel reads only the names in its own map.
Steps 1-3 read no weight bytes. The check in step 2 looks in one direction only.
missing shard -> FileNotFoundError; bad shard or name -> ValueError
a param with no source -> RuntimeError; an unused tensor -> nothing
ordinary params: shape, dtype, FP32 HC/sink; tied aliases -> ValueError
byte range, short read; FP8 weight with no .scale -> KeyError; expert asserts
Names are examples. Scale tensors (X.scale) are never mapped as parameters (weights.py:95).
Not shown: vision names (vision_pipeline.aligner.*), the model. prefix rule, and the expert count check per layer.
